units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: handheld, slowly accelerating sideways move (translation with parallax); scene content drifts RIGHT in the image, faster for nearer layers
camera.shift_profile: dx(floor) by frame: f7 5.6, f14 19.7, f21 49.9, f28 87.3 (accelerating; near 0 for the first few frames)
camera.scale_change: none measurable (truck length constant ~312 px; armchair width 320->323 px)

objects.name: toy_truck
objects.description: toy dump truck: blue cab with yellow driver figure, red dump bed, yellow chassis, 4 black wheels; the only clearly moving object
objects.motion: rolls right-to-left (towards the child) along the floor, parallel to the image plane; already moving at frame 0 after a push by the man
objects.reference_point: bbox centre (cx, cy); front_x = leftmost blue pixel of the cab (leading edge, never occluded)

pixel_size.length_note: median bbox width frames 3-28 (range 310-318); frames 0-2 read 304-306 because the rear is hidden by the man's knee

objects.name: man
objects.description: adult in black T-shirt and blue jeans, crouching at right, face blurred; pushed the truck
objects.moves: small body movements only; image drift follows the camera (~+90 px by f28)
objects.note: bbox read by eye from grid frames (+-10 px); crouching, not standing height

objects.name: child
objects.description: toddler in dark blue shirt and shorts, black/white sneakers, sitting on the floor against the red sofa at left, legs stretched towards the truck; face blurred
objects.moves: small (legs/arms); image drift follows the camera (~+70 px by f28)
objects.leg_extent_note: hip to shoe tip ~ 270 px horizontally

objects.name: red_sofa
objects.description: large orange-red sofa at left, back to the child
objects.note: extends past the left image edge

objects.name: red_armchair
objects.description: red armchair centre background on metal feet

objects.name: small_black_stool
objects.description: small round side table/stool with black legs between sofa and armchair

objects.name: bar_stools
objects.description: wicker/dark bar stools and table at right background

objects.name: coffee_table_and_back_sofa
objects.description: dark sofa with cushions and coffee table at top-left background

objects.name: floor_tiles
objects.description: large glossy grey tiles with dark grout; strong reflections

objects.name: window_sill
objects.description: foreground window frame / sill spanning the bottom of the image (y ~ 800-1000) with LED strip at lower right

events.event: truck already rolling at first frame (push happened before the clip); man's hand near the bed rear frames 0-3, no clear contact
truck rear no longer hidden by the man's knee
cab front starts to overlap (pass in front of) the child's right shoe in the image
clip ends; truck still moving (~10-17 px/frame floor-compensated)

files.tracks/camera_shift.csv: per-frame cumulative background shift by depth band
files.tracks/camera_phasecorr.csv: phase-correlation shift of far band and sill (cross-check)
